description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join the data infrastructure team to build and extend a query engine for graph-native queries across enterprise data sources. Your work will help make complex business data accessible for reliable AI applications.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and extend compiler and executor components to support new query language features and functions.

 - Build and optimize graph-native queries that reason across multiple data sources.

 - Develop pass-through query logic for customer data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Oracle.

 - Partner with the platform team to improve performance, reliability, and scalability.

 - Debug and resolve complex query execution issues in production environments.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 4 years building databases, data infrastructure, or distributed data systems.

 - Experience with database or query engine internals, such as query planning and optimization, execution engines, compilers, or storage engines.

 - Strong systems programming skills in C++, Rust, or Java.

 - Experience optimizing query performance in high-volume or latency-sensitive environments.

 - Knowledge of SQL, query optimization, compiler design, and data platforms or engines such as Snowflake, Databricks, Oracle, Trino, Spark, BigQuery, or DuckDB.

 - Experience with distributed query processing, federated execution, graph databases, or semantic layer systems is valuable.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Mateo, United States.
